cases.symptom: 多次返回城市天气页刷新预报后，应用内存持续升高。
cases.scenario: Refresh the saved city forecasts
cases.mechanism: getWeatherUtil.getWeather creates a new http.createHttp() session for every weather request, retains the session and the full response body in the viewmodel, and never calls request.destroy(). Each city refresh leaks an HTTP session plus its complete response for the lifetime of the app, so repeated refreshes and multi-city loads accumulate retained memory. The revised business-only workload uses all ten already-supported cities, ordinary seven-day hourly responses, an accessible detail page displaying all hourly fields, and identical bundled weather icons. Synthetic fixture values are identical between variants; actual retrieval time is displayed separately. The performance claim is warmed process-PSS growth, not a count of retained sockets or exact live malloc bytes. No payload padding or artificial service delay is used. PSS boundaries follow successful system GC requests and fixed waits; completed GC, exact live-heap ownership, and file-descriptor counts are not claimed.
